talk.title: Proverbs

talk.title: Is it enough?
talk.task: Claude asks about sleep, money, distance and school subjects. Answer in full sentences.
talk.claudePrompt: You are my English speaking partner. I am practicing subject-verb agreement with amounts and special nouns. Ask me one question at a time: How many hours of sleep is enough for you? What is a reasonable amount of money to pay for textbooks for one term? What is a manageable distance to travel to work? Which school subject (mathematics, physics, ...) is easy for you? What advantages do the old have over the young? I answer in full sentences. Check that I use a singular verb with amounts of time, money and distance and with subjects like mathematics, and a plural verb with 'the old', 'the young' and 'people'.
